summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (bug fixes & test infrastructure), get a PR merged, and fix a flaky recovery E2E test that was failing due to IPNS resolution issues in CI.
summary.outcome: Phase 24 merged with all 3 plans complete. Discovered and fixed a fundamental gap where the SDK never published the vault key blob IPNS record during vault init, which was needed for recovery to work. Extracted vault key blob publish into sdk-core as `publishVaultKeyBlob`.

repo: The vault key blob IPNS record is published exclusively by the web app's `useAuth.ts` hook, not the SDK — making `createTestAccount` and any SDK-only vault init incomplete for recovery scenarios.
In CI, IPNS records are published through mock-ipns-routing (port 3001) via delegated routing, not Kubo's DHT. Kubo's gateway at 8080 cannot resolve these records locally.
The CipherBox API's `/ipns/resolve` endpoint requires JWT authentication — recovery.html (unauthenticated) cannot use it as a fallback.

The orval-generated API client functions (e.g. `ipnsControllerPublishRecord`) fall back to a global singleton when no `axiosInstance` is on the `SdkContext`. Tests must pass an explicit `axiosInstance` created via `createAxiosInstance()` to avoid `API client not configured` errors.
Device registry now has v1/v2 schema versioning with lenient v1 migration and `validateDeviceEntryBase` for shared validation. New registries are created as v2.
The bin IPNS 404 auto-repair uses `publishWithVerify` which publishes once then retries only the verification step — NOT re-publishing on every retry attempt.
mock-ipns-routing CORS must be configured for browser-based recovery.html to reach it from localhost:5173. Added `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` with GET+OPTIONS methods.
The `window.location.origin.replace(/:\d+$/, ':3000')` pattern in recovery.html derives the API base URL from the current tab's origin — works for localhost:5173 → localhost:3000.

code.finding: New module: `publishVaultKeyBlob` (derives keypair, serializes v2 blob, uploads to IPFS, publishes IPNS) and `loadVaultKeyBlob` (resolves IPNS, fetches from IPFS, deserializes). Extracted from useAuth.ts.
Vault key blob IPNS is published here using `deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair`, `serializeVaultBlobV2`, `addToIpfs`, `createAndPublishIpnsRecord` — all of which are now also in the SDK vault module.

ipHash migration is intentionally strict: only auto-heals empty string (`''`), rejects other malformed values. `validateRegistryShape()` extracted to deduplicate v1/v2 validation. After refactor, `obj.devices` needed `as unknown[]` cast since TypeScript doesn't propagate narrowing across function boundaries (TS18046).

`publishWithVerify` now publishes once, then retries verification only. `loadBin` auto-repair triggers when `resolveIpnsRecord` returns null (API says not found) — transient failures throw instead of returning null, so auto-repair is not triggered on network errors.

`createTestAccount` was missing vault key blob publish. Now calls `publishVaultKeyBlob` after vault registration with an explicit `axiosInstance` constructed from `createAxiosInstance(apiUrl, getToken)`.

IPFS_GATEWAY defaults to `localhost:8080`, IPNS_GATEWAY derives from `DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL` env var (defaults to `localhost:3001` = mock-ipns-routing). Content fetch goes through Kubo, IPNS resolution goes through mock routing.
CORS headers added with `GET, OPTIONS` only — necessary for browser-side recovery.html to reach delegated routing endpoint from a different port.

`cid` and `pinSize` must be declared with `let` above the `try` block to be accessible in `finally`. TypeScript scopes `let` declarations to their enclosing block — `finally` is a sibling of `try`, not nested inside it.

workflow: When agents commit with `--no-verify` in parallel worktrees, TypeScript declaration files (.d.ts) can become stale. Rebuilding affected packages (`pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build`) regenerates them and resolves apparent type errors that aren't real bugs.

The `classifyHandoffIfNeeded is not defined` error from Claude Code subagents is a runtime bug fired after all tool calls complete — spot-check SUMMARY.md + commits to confirm success rather than treating it as a real failure.
CodeRabbit and Copilot reviews arrive within minutes of PR creation — resolve them before merging rather than after.
When debugging test failures, downloading Playwright artifacts (`error-context.md`) is faster than parsing raw logs — it contains the page's visible error text and screenshot.
For E2E tests that depend on background services, check which IPNS publish path the SDK actually uses vs what the test harness assumes — SDK shortcuts can silently skip production publish flows.

friction: Multiple CI failures on the recovery E2E test required 4 separate PRs (#363, #364, #365, #367) iterating through: missing SDK_E2E_SECRET → API requires JWT auth → mock-ipns-routing lacks CORS → vault key blob never published by SDK.

The `publishWithVerify` refactor (publish-once, retry-verify) required updating the SDK E2E bin test assertion for `sequenceNumber` from 0 to 1 — easy to miss that behavior change cascaded to integration tests.

TypeScript TS18046 (`'obj.devices' is of type 'unknown'`) surfaced only in CI, not locally, because the `validateRegistryShape` helper doesn't propagate narrowing to callers — required an explicit `as unknown[]` cast.
git stash was needed mid-session when switching branches with uncommitted `recovery.spec.ts` changes from local debugging.
GitHub API timeouts during CI failure debugging required retrying `gh run view` multiple times.
Docker host IP change (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) caused all local API/IPFS connections to fail silently until `.env` was updated.
open_items: Remove mock-ipns-routing from CI once the API publishes vault key blobs through the same delegated routing path — tracked as a todo in `.planning/todos/pending/`.
Update `useAuth.ts` to call the new SDK `publishVaultKeyBlob` function instead of duplicating the derive+serialize+upload+publish logic inline.
Recovery E2E test is now wired correctly but has never passed in CI — verify it passes once PR #368 merges.
PR #367 was closed without merging — verify its CORS changes for mock-ipns-routing were already on main via PR #365 (confirmed they were).

6 pending todos remain: Web Worker large file encryption, ERC-1271 contract wallet auth, CRDT IPNS inbox research, async incremental search index, alternative MFA factor types, investigate mock-ipns-routing removal.
